policy.primary_price_policy: The same prior completed minute for every entry in a transaction. Verified-contract Coinbase USD spot; verified secondary venues and actual USDTUSD conversion explicitly recorded. Missing quotes remain unpriced, never zero.
policy.bitquery_comparison_policy: Separate stablecoin-USD1 sensitivity, retaining the same prior-completed-minute quote clock. Bitquery used same-minute Hyperliquid marks and different chain cutoffs; this is not called exact replication.
policy.primary_identity: Signed hacker reference loss after own onchain cost = signed non-hacker asset/position changes + protocol fee burn. Unpriced asset vectors conserve separately. These are reference-value changes, not historical cost-basis or causal MEV profits.
policy.proposer_rule: Searcher/block-recipient fees appear once in the primary table. Actual proposer payouts are a secondary redistribution and are not added to primary extraction. The event share is not inferred from the whole block payout.
policy.control_rule: Before the first monitored target at a pool is control. Other calls or pools in the same transaction are execution context. Same-pool activity after a target is association, not proof of incident causation.
